Now, researchers at Hokkaido University have discovered a new crystal structure of silver with unusually high chemical reactivity.

top.title: Atmospheric organic nitrogen emerges as a major nutrient source for global oceans
top.summary: A research team has quantified an important component of the global nitrogen cycle.

top.title: Robot submarine exploring world's deepest ocean trench finds unprecedented volcanic activity
top.summary: Fifty-two million years ago, the Pacific tectonic plate began to slide under the Philippine Sea plate, forming the Mariana Trench, the deepest known valley on the Earth's ocean floor. The deepest part of this abyss, the Challenger Deep, is almost 11,000 meters (36,000 feet) below sea level.

top.title: JWST finds a possible black hole that grew faster than its host galaxy in the early universe
top.summary: How the first massive black holes formed in the universe remains an open question in astronomy. Black holes weighing about a billion solar masses within the first billion years of the universe require extraordinary origin stories.

more.title: DNA’s secret sunscreen may have helped life survive on early Earth
more.summary: Scientists have uncovered a surprising reason why early life may have survived Earth's intense ultraviolet radiation: a key component of DNA appears to turn potentially destructive damage into something easier to repair. The discovery could help solve a decades-old evolutionary mystery and reveal how life endured the harsh conditions of our planet's earliest days.

more.title: Reliance on technology is eroding trust in one another and ability to tell what is even real, expert warns
more.summary: The danger of generative AI is not some distant algorithmic failure; it is the slow erosion of our ability to tell what's real, to trust our institutions and to think for ourselves at all. These are the warnings of Mateusz Łabuz in his new book, The End of Reality.

more.title: Milky Way simulation reaches record resolution with the help of three supercomputers

They simulated the entire galaxy down to the level of individual stars by combining the power of some of the world's most powerful supercomputers using an AI-accelerated model that works on a variety of hardware platforms.

more.title: Parasite makes mice more attractive to blood-feeding bugs, which may aid its spread
more.summary: Some parasites, such as Trypanosoma rangeli and Trypanosoma cruzi, can be passed between mammals and blood-feeding insects called triatomine bugs. Bugs can acquire these parasites when feeding on infected mammals, while mammals can also become infected through encounters with infected bugs.

more.title: A mysterious gap hints at black holes born from stars that never exploded
more.summary: Massive stars may be quietly collapsing into black holes without ever producing the spectacular supernova explosions scientists typically expect. A surprising pattern in 257 black hole mergers suggests these mysterious stellar disappearances could explain the origins of a large population of black holes throughout the universe.

more.title: A 194-year-old tortoise has a remarkable anti-aging secret hidden in its DNA
